summary: October brings autumn colour in the north and the start of the dry season in many tropical places.
intro: Autumn colours reach their peak across Canada, New England and much of Europe, and later in the month in Japan, and city breaks are comfortable again after the summer heat. Oktoberfest usually ends in the first days of the month.
In much of India and South-East Asia the rains are easing, and the long dry, cooler season is about to begin. In the southern hemisphere spring is well under way.
